voice: espeak-ng + MBROLA us2, rate 160, pitch 40, word gap 3 (door line: rate 132, pitch 34; last line: rate 118, pitch 30)

lines.text: You are alone up here until morning. Follow these rules.
lines.beat_before: hook: the rule sheet by the monitor, snow on the window

lines.text: One. Record the temperature every hour.
lines.beat_before: the cable car leaves; the station alone on the ridge

lines.text: Two. The wind sensor reports wind on calm nights. Do not go up to check.
lines.beat_before: pen on the log; the cups spinning on a still night

lines.text: Three. If the phone rings, let it ring. There is no phone line.
lines.beat_before: the phone, its cord cut, rings

lines.text: Four. If you see footprints to the door, turn off every light.
lines.beat_before: through the east window: smooth snow, then prints

lines.text: Six. At four a.m., someone will say they are the morning shift.

lines.beat_before: the same voice, outside the door

lines.text: The morning shift arrives at seven. Do not open.
Especially if you recognise the voice.
Seven. If you do not remember writing tonight's log, you did not write it.
